title: 港町の一日(曲もセリフも無し)
description: 物語の文章だけから 60 秒・8 シーン。参照画像なし(T2VA)、H3 の環境音をそのまま残す。

values.story: 小さな港町の一日。夜明けの灯台、漁師たちの帰港、市場の賑わい、夕方の海に沈む太陽。人物は登場しない。波と風とカモメの声。

outline.title: 港町の調べ (Port Town's Melody)
outline.setting: A small, tranquil coastal town experiencing the full cycle of a single day
outline.characters: None. Focus is on natural elements: waves, wind, seagulls
outline.arc: The narrative follows the transition from the quiet solitude of dawn to the vibrant energy of midday, settling into the peaceful grandeur of sunset
continuity_rules: The color palette must transition smoothly from cool blues and greys at dawn to warm oranges and deep purples by sunset

Sound design is paramount: the soundscape should evolve from gentle, rhythmic lapping waves to bustling activity (though no people are shown clearly) and finally back to vast silence punctuated by wind and gulls
The visual texture of water—from misty morning fog to sharp midday sunlight reflecting off wet wood—must remain consistent within each location's sequence
